# STATUS format

`qa/STATUS.md` is the one page the user looks at. `qa status --write` regenerates it from the other files after every run, so never edit its tables by hand. The user can tick its boxes and answer its questions in the file. At the start of the next run, `qa ingest` reads them and the lead applies them.

```markdown
<!-- enhance-qa: generated by `qa status --write`. Tick a box, or write "→ your answer" after an item. -->
# QA status · Build 12 · 16 Nov 2026, 21:40
**Verdict: Not ready.** 1 major bug open · last pass: check, 9 min, ~$0.40

## Needs you
- [ ] BUG-018 "Delete account" has no confirmation step. Bug, or by design?
- [ ] BUG-021 The fix changes the checkout wording. OK to apply?

| Severity | Bug | Area | Status |

| S2 major | [BUG-019](bugs/BUG-019.md) A wrong password shows a 500 page | auth | open |
| S3 minor | [BUG-020](bugs/BUG-020.md) Typo on the pricing page | pricing | fixed, awaiting verification |

Cosmetic (S4): 2 open, listed in [coverage.md](coverage.md)

## Human checks for this build
- [ ] VIS-003 The new logo looks right in dark mode
- [ ] AUD-002 The alert sound isn't too loud

## Coverage by area
| Area | Checks | Passed | Failed | Not run yet | Last run |

| auth | 18 | 17 | 1 | 0 | build 12 |

| Run | Build | Pass | Result |

| [012](runs/012-check.md) | 12 | check | 31 passed, 2 failed, 2 new bugs |
```

## How the user answers

| The user writes | Meaning | What the lead does |
|---|---|---|
| `- [x] VIS-003 …` | Did the human check, and it's fine | Records `pass-human` for the current build |
| `- [ ] VIS-003 … → fails: logo is blurry` | Did it, and it failed | Files a bug from the note (source: reported) |
| `- [x] BUG-018 … → by design` | Decision on a bug | Sets `by-design`, updates the check's expected result, and logs the decision with the date |
| `→ bug` / `→ fix it` | It's a bug; go ahead | Sets `open`; the fix flow allows it |
| `→ later` / `→ defer` | Not now | Sets `deferred` |
| `→ waive` | Release can go without it | Records `waived` with the date |
| `→ not useful` | Stop reporting this kind of thing | Tags `not-useful`; adds a "Don't report" line to `qa/notes.md` |
| Any other text after `→` | A free-text answer | The lead reads it and acts, or asks again if it's unclear |

`qa ingest --json` lists every ticked box and every answer, with the item it belongs to. Answers that need judgement go to the lead; mechanical ones (`pass-human`, `waived`, `deferred`) are applied by the lead with `qa bug set` and `qa result add`.
